theme_strategy: Modern Professional (Light Theme Priority). Soft Utility blended with Swiss Authority. High structural clarity, accessible contrast, and professional aesthetics tailored for prolonged workspace usage.

rules: NEVER use generic sans for headings. Use 'Outfit' for crisp, professional headers.
Jump between headings must not exceed 2 Tailwind steps.
Line height: leading-none for headers, leading-relaxed for body.

colors.palette_archetype: The Swiss High-Contrast mixed with Soft Utility

backgrounds.page: bg-slate-50 (#F8FAFC) - Never pure white for the main canvas.
backgrounds.sidebar: bg-white (#FFFFFF) with a 1px solid border-r border-slate-200.

colors.brand_primary: bg-indigo-600 (#4F46E5) - Used strictly for primary CTAs (e.g., 'New Task', 'Start Timer').
colors.accent_alert: bg-orange-500 (#F97316) - Used for active time tracking or overdue tasks.
rules: NO full-screen gradients. Color is for function and guiding action.
Hover state color MUST be explicitly defined (e.g., hover:bg-indigo-700 hover:text-white).
Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio for normal text.

surfaces: Neumorphism (Tactile): Used for dashboard widgets. Mix soft shadows with crisp 1px inner contrast borders (border-slate-100) to ensure accessibility.
Glassmorphism: Used for Sticky Navs and Overlays. Use high opacity bg-white/70 with backdrop-blur-xl and a delicate 1px border-slate-200/50.
Grid Borders: Expose the structural grid for data-heavy views (List, Workload).
visual_enhancers.border_radius: max 8px (rounded-lg) for a professional, crisp feel. Never use fully rounded pills for content cards.

components.strategy: Shadcn UI + Custom HTML/Tailwind for structural asymmetry.

specific_components.sidebar: Collapsible left-sidebar containing org-switcher, navigation links, and user profile.
specific_components.org_switcher: Dropdown menu in the top-left corner of sidebar. Include dummy organization logos.
specific_components.time_tracker: Floating or sticky widget in the top navigation or bottom right. Must have high-contrast active state (Orange).

task_views.list: Data table with border-collapse and subtle row hover effects.
task_views.kanban: Horizontal scrolling flex container with distinct column backgrounds (bg-slate-50) and draggable card widgets.
task_views.gantt: Timeline visualization using dense grid columns.
task_views.calendar: Shadcn Calendar integrated into a full-page grid layout.
task_views.workload: Bar charts or stacked capacity meters.

specific_components.forms: Use Shadcn Input, Select, and Dialog for task creation and sprint planning.

components.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone or Regular) for a professional, clear aesthetic. Install via: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react
components.charts: Use Shadcn charts (Recharts under the hood) for achievements, workload, and productivity metrics.

bento_protocol.rules: Every pixel must be utilized. Use h-full on children to ensure they stretch. No jagged bottoms.

grids_layouts.spacing_scale: Use generous padding inside containers. Cards must have p-6 or p-8.
grids_layouts.alignment: Left-align paragraphs, labels, dense content. Buttons align relative to their container.

rules: Add hover states (transform -translate-y-[2px], shadow-md) for task cards.
Use staggered entrance animations for list items.
Smooth state changes using targeted transitions (transition-colors, transition-transform) - NEVER use transition-all.

accessibility.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 for standard text. Minimum 3:1 for large text and interactive boundaries.
accessibility.focus: Focus states must have HIGHER contrast (e.g., focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:outline-none).
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='create-task-button').
accessibility.charts: Color-blind friendly palettes for productivity metrics.

image_urls.description: Real photo of a professional man in a suit for manager/admin role

media.rules: Never use placeholder images. Use provided URLs. Apply appropriate object-cover and rounded-full classes for avatars.

universal_guidelines: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Break the mold: make a creative, distinctive frontend.
Do not center-align the app container. Do not use `.App { text-align: center; }`.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠) for icons. Use Phosphor Icons.
Ensure the header/top navigation has a background (not completely transparent) if content scrolls beneath it.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Prevent cramped UI.
Create depth through layered z-index hierarchies and crisp shadows.
Do not apply 'transition: all' globally. Use targeted transitions.
Prioritize pre-existing Shadcn components. Override styles (like h-9 for tabs) carefully using Tailwind.
instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: `yarn add @phosphor-icons/react recharts date-fns`
Configure Shadcn UI if not already done, prioritizing standard components: button, input, select, dialog, tabs, dropdown-menu, avatar, table, calendar, popover.
Structure the layout with a fixed left Sidebar and a main content area with a sticky top header.
Implement the 5 views (List, Board, Gantt, Calendar, Workload) using a Tabs-like or Sub-nav switcher.
Implement the Time Tracker with state management (Start/Stop). It should visually indicate when active (e.g., using the orange accent color).
Build the dashboard tab containing summary metrics and charts (productivity, completed tasks) using recharts.
Use the provided image URLs for user avatars in the header, task assignees, and the organization switcher.
Mock the authentication flow if no real backend is provided. The multi-org switcher should just toggle state in the frontend mockup.
